% Shift-family specificity of the training-induced degradation.
% Data (generated by make_revalidation_macros.py):
%   data/fig_family_freq.csv   S2 and 1000 ns at 5 dB, mean over 7 trajectories (dense_eval.csv)
%   data/fig_family_dop.csv    250 and 400 km/h at 10 dB, mean over 7 trajectories (traj_extra.csv)
%   data/fig_family_v150.csv   150 km/h at 10 dB, mean over 7 trajectories (traj_doppler.csv)
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ieee, width=0.86\columnwidth, height=0.60\columnwidth, ymode=log,
  xmin=0, xmax=51000, ymin=1e-4, ymax=1.2,
  xtick={0,10000,20000,30000,40000,50000}, xticklabels={$0$,$1$,$2$,$3$,$4$,$5$},
  scaled x ticks=false, xlabel={Training iteration $t$ ($\times 10^{4}$)},
  ylabel={Block error rate}, legend style={at={(0.02,0.03)}, anchor=south west},
  legend columns=2]
\addplot[cAINR, solid, line width=1.1pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=S2] {data/fig_family_freq.csv};
\addlegendentry{S2, $5$~dB}
\addplot[cAINR, densely dashed, line width=0.9pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=DS] {data/fig_family_freq.csv};
\addlegendentry{$1000$~ns, $5$~dB}
\addplot[cOrange, solid, line width=0.9pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=V150] {data/fig_family_v150.csv};
\addlegendentry{$150$~km/h, $10$~dB}
\addplot[cSky, densely dotted, line width=1.0pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=V250] {data/fig_family_dop.csv};
\addlegendentry{$250$~km/h, $10$~dB}
\addplot[cGrey, dashdotted, line width=0.9pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=V400] {data/fig_family_dop.csv};
\addlegendentry{$400$~km/h, $10$~dB}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
